data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,type,created_by,colonists_ore,slave_unrest_level,production_last_tick) SELECT 1,'v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa',player_id,'player','M',100,'SLAVE',pt.planettypes_id,player_id,100,0,-1 FROM players CROSS JOIN planettypes pt WHERE players.name='System' AND pt.code='V3_UNREST_QA'

INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) SELECT p.planet_id,q.c,0,10000,0 FROM planets p CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('ORE'),('ORG'),('EQU')) q(c) WHERE p.name IN ('v3_unrest_slave_qa','v3_unrest_colonist_qa','v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa')

INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) SELECT 'planet',p.planet_id,q.c,0,0 FROM planets p CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('ORE'),('ORG'),('EQU')) q(c) WHERE p.name IN ('v3_unrest_slave_qa','v3_unrest_colonist_qa','v3_unrest_slave_ratio_qa')
